title: Jubilant Syrian Lentil Wrap
description: A vegan-friendly, fermented Syrian dish featuring unsalted butter and ssam-wrap, served in a mason jar, perfect for curing hangovers. This springy wrap is filled with flavorful lentils and spices.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the lentils, then transfer them to a large pot with 2 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked lentils to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Warm the ssam wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the lentil mixture onto a piece of ssam wrap and squeezing a piece of unsalted butter on top.
Serve the wraps in a mason jar, drizzled with lemon juice.
